title: 피디수첩 같은 데서  (On a Show Like PD Note)

segments.t: Seung-chan's parents are thrilled to have a producer in the family. His father brings up a friend's unfair eviction, hoping Seung-chan will cover it on the news, forgetting that his son works in the variety department. Listen for "jebo", 'tip-off', and "yeneungguk", 'variety department'.
아, 그리고 아버지 고등학교 동창이 너한테 제보할 게 있다더니.
주인이 프랜차이즈 뭐 큰 게 들어온다고,
피디수첩 같은 데서 좀 다뤄 달라고.
Let's unpack the father's big misunderstanding.
Seung-chan finishes talking about his senior. He says "jagineun geureon saram anirago", 'she is not that kind of person'.
His mother praises the senior. She says "yeuiga bareune", 'she is polite'.
His father agrees. He says "dangyeonhan geoji", 'it is natural'.
아, 그리고 아버지 고등학교 동창이 너한테 제보할 게 있다더니.
His father brings up a favor. He uses "dongchang", 'classmate', and "jebo", 'tip-off'.
Seung-chan asks for details. He says "museun yegiimnikka", 'what is the story'.
주인이 프랜차이즈 뭐 큰 게 들어온다고,
The father starts the tragic tale. He mentions the "juin", 'landlord', and a "peuraenchaijeu", 'franchise'.
The landlord was cruel. He told him to leave without a "gwonrigeum", the 'premium' or 'key money'.
Seung-chan is confused. He asks "wae jeohante", 'why to me'.
His father boasts. He says "uri adeuri", 'our son', and "pidirago hanikka", 'because I said you are a producer'.
피디수첩 같은 데서 좀 다뤄 달라고.
He suggests a serious investigative journalism show. He uses "daryeo dallago", 'please deal with it'.
Seung-chan breaks the bad news. He reminds his father that he is in the "yeneungguk", 'variety department'. Now let's listen to this funny family moment again.
아, 그리고 아버지 고등학교 동창이 너한테 제보할 게 있다더니.
주인이 프랜차이즈 뭐 큰 게 들어온다고,
피디수첩 같은 데서 좀 다뤄 달라고.
Don't forget the word "yeneungguk". Keep practicing so you can handle any "jebo"!

lines.fragment: 아, 그리고 아버지 고등학교 동창이 너한테 제보할 게 있다더니.

우리 아들이 KBS 피디라고 하니까 이런 걸
